body_markdown:
TAMPA, Fla. –


Limbach Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: LMB) (“Limbach” or the “Company”), a building systems solutions firm that partners with building owners and operators of mission-critical mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls (“MEPC”) infrastructure, today announced the appointment of Adam Prior as Vice President of Investor Relations and Corporate Strategy, reporting to Michael McCann, President and Chief Executive Officer of Limbach.


Mr. Prior will work closely with the senior management team to advance Limbach’s long-term strategy and lead its engagement with the investment community. His responsibilities will include financial communications, strategic planning, market and competitive analysis, and supporting the evaluation of growth opportunities.


“We are pleased to welcome Adam to Limbach,” said Mr. McCann. “Adam brings extensive experience in corporate strategy and investor relations, a strong understanding of capital markets and an established network of relationships across the investment community. His ability to connect business strategy with investor perspectives will be valuable as we continue with our plans to expand our geographic footprint, pursue disciplined growth and build long-term value for our stockholders.”


Mr. Prior brings more than 25 years of experience in investor relations, corporate strategy and financial communications to Limbach. He most recently served as Director of Investor Relations at New Jersey Resources (NYSE: NJR), where he led the company’s engagement with shareholders and analysts and worked with senior management on financial communications and strategic positioning.


Before joining New Jersey Resources, Mr. Prior spent more than two decades at The Equity Group Inc., most recently as Senior Vice President. In that role, he advised management teams of publicly traded companies across multiple industries on communications strategy and shareholder engagement.


“Limbach’s combination of technical expertise, deep customer relationships and an integrated operating model creates a compelling opportunity for long-term growth,” said Mr. Prior. “The Company has a clear strategy to expand its reach, serve customers more broadly and build on its position in mission-critical markets. I’m excited to work with Mike and senior leadership to advance these initiatives and communicate Limbach’s long-term growth potential to the investment community.”


**About Limbach**


Limbach is a building systems solutions firm that designs, delivers, and maintains mechanical (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), electrical, plumbing, and controls (“MEPC”) systems that support life’s most important moments. We partner with building owners and operators of mission-critical facilities across healthcare, industrial and manufacturing, data centers, life sciences, higher education, and cultural and entertainment markets. With approximately 2,100 team members across 23 offices throughout the Eastern and Midwestern regions of the United States, we strive to be an indispensable partner by combining our national capabilities with strong local execution and talent to deliver proactive, safe, and reliable solutions for complex facilities. Operating on a connected platform, we integrate engineering expertise with field execution to provide customized MEPC infrastructure solutions that address both operational and capital project needs, optimizing performance, enhancing reliability, and ensuring long-term safety.
